Who is BowWow?

To rescue , must enter located in and defeat who will comment on 's objective. After is defeated, can be found chained to a rock in the next room. If returns to before completing , she will ask to take for a walk.

While is taking for a walk, he will have many interactions with the world such as telling where to dig for , swallowing enemies such as , which are blocking the entrance to . Although he allows to clear the entrance of the , he can not enter it himself. If has completed the and calls , he will tell to bring back to . When he does, she will take back and express her gratitude in the form of a kiss, which fully heals 's .

In , after has returned and has met the , he can stand next to and let the take a for that he will name "".

In the , first sees when strolling around , where she attempts to eat him before brings her real dinner. After returns to the , tells him that was kidnapped by . then proceeds to rescue her from . After exiting, he takes to to clear the path of . While exploring the area, finds the hidden entrance to . After clearing the dungeon, takes back to , who rewards him with an .
